== Abstract ==

A year-long series of observational and experimental field studies in three cafeterias of an English university (94,644 meals, 2017). Doubling the proportion of vegetarian meals on offer from 25% to 50% increased vegetarian meal sales by 14.9 and 14.5 percentage points in the observational study and by 7.8 percentage points in the experimental study (proportional increases of 61.8%, 78.8%, and 40.8%). The largest effects were in the quartile of diners with the lowest prior vegetarian selection; overall sales were largely unaffected and no rebound effect was detected.
